module.label: Twitch companion clips
module.description: Creates a Twitch clip independently of the local OBS save.

flows.label: A replay save or moderator requests a clip
flows.detail: Highlight saves and moderator !clip share one 60-second Twitch request and a 90-second global cooldown, including uncertain failures. Chat attaches to the pending result or reuses its confirmed link without another POST; observers are bounded. Labels or current stream title/category plus local date/time form readable titles. Confirmation verifies the published duration; shorter clips retain their link and report an error without creating a duplicate. Local OBS saving is independent. Shutdown uses the published stop signal and joins the worker.

steps.label: Twitch session available?
steps.detail: Reject a second creation inside the 90-second window; at most 32 chat callbacks may observe pending work, and completed results can be reused.

steps.label: Request a 60-second Twitch clip
steps.detail: Request duration=60 with a clean descriptive title. Optional channel metadata has a five-second bound and a title fallback.

steps.label: Wait for confirmation
steps.detail: Poll only the created ID; accept a published duration within 0.1 seconds of 60. Report shorter clips honestly with their link, without retrying creation.

steps.label: Ready or failed independently
steps.detail: Never holds up or invalidates the local OBS clip.
